note: The teal's voice (B3, the winter duck flock; doc 17 'Procedural creature voices'). Made in code like the turnstones' (src/audio/voices/teal.js), not recordings, so there is no licence to carry. When: src/app/teal.js says each one, where it comes from, to the creatures bus, quiet in the soundscape (gainDb). krik: the drake's short, clear, ringing double whistle 'krrik', every krikEveryS real seconds from the flock while they swim: chirps (usually two) of chirpS, gapS apart, a sine at f0Hz (each call its own within the range) rising by rise then falling by droop, a little second harmonic (harmonic) for the ring, and the opening share of each chirp (trillShare) rolled by a trill (trillHz, trillDepth) for the 'rr'. murmur: a few soft low nasal quacks of the duck at rest and at night (murmurEveryS): notes of noteS, gapS apart, a sawtooth at f0Hz dipping by droop through a nasal formant (formantHz, formantQ). whirr: the flock flushing: filtered noise (noiseHz, noiseQ) beating at wingHz for durS (attackS in, then fading), with krikCalls krik calls over it, each up to krikSpreadS after the start. spatial: refDistance and rolloff of the placed chain.
